p: me from: This is spoken in the person of Christ, to assure the faithful that these promises should come to pass: for they were all made in him and in him would be performed.
the womb: This is meant of the time that Christ would be manifested to the world, as in Ps 2:7.
sword: By the sword and shaft, he signifies the virtue and efficacy of Christ's doctrine.
hid me: God has taken me to his protection and defence: this chiefly is meant of Christ, and may also be applied to the ministers of his word.
Israel: By Israel is meant Christ, and all the body of the faithful, as the members and their head.
laboured in vain: Thus Christ in his members complains that his labour and preaching take no effect, yet he is contented that his doings are approved by God.
yet shall I be glorious in: Though the Jews refuse my doctrine, yet God will approve my ministry.
thee for a light to the: To declare my gospel to the Gentiles, as in Isa 42:6, Ac 13:47, Lu 2:32.
servant of rulers: Meaning, the Jews whom tyrants kept in bondage.
arise: The benefit of their deliverance will be so great, that great and small will acknowledge it, and revere God for it.
In an acceptable time have I: Thus he speaks of his Church when he would show his mercy toward it, 2Co 6:2.
thee for a covenant of the: Meaning, Christ alone.
earth: Signifying that before Christ renewed the earth by his word, there is nothing but confusion and disorder.
prisoners: To them who are in the prison of sin and death.
pastures shall be in all high: Being in Christ's protection, they will be safe against all dangers, and free from fear of the enemies.
on them shall lead them: Meaning, that there would be nothing in their way from Babylon that would hinder or hurt them: but this is accomplished spiritually.
Sinim: Meaning, the south country, so that Christ will deliver his from all the parts of the world.
heavens: Read Isa 44:23.
forsaken me: He objects what the faithful might say in their long affliction and answers to comfort them with a most proper comparison and full of consolation.
hands: Because I would not forget you.
walls are continually before me: Meaning, the good order of policy and discipline.
haste: I have continual care to build you up again and to destroy your enemies.
clothe thee with them all: He shows what are the ornaments of the Church: to have many children, who are assembled by the word of God, and governed by his Spirit.
Gentiles: He shows that Christ will not only gather this great number from the Jews but also from the Gentiles.
shall be thy nursing fathers: Meaning, that kings will be converted to the gospel, and bestow their power and authority for the preservation of the Church.
dust of thy feet: Being joined with the Church, they will humble themselves to Christ their head, and give him all honour.
taken from the mighty: He makes this as an objection as though the Chaldeans were strong, and had them in just possession.
Even the captives of the mighty: This is the answer to their objection, that no one is stronger than the Lord, neither has a more just title to them.
their own flesh: I will cause them to destroy one another as in Jud 7:22, 2Ch 20:22, Isa 19:2.
